datasets.title: Satellite detected water extent in Baghlan-e-Jadid District, Baghlan Province, Afghanistan as of 14 May 2024
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20240512AFG, GDACS ID: 1102616 This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in Baghlan-e-Jadid District, Baghlan Province, Afghanistan as observed from a Pléiades image acquired on 14 May 2024 at 10:48 local time (06:18 UTC). Within the analysed area of about 420 ha, a total of about 90 ha of lands appear to be affected by flood waters. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified 259 affected structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-in-baghlan-e-jadid-district-baghlan-province-afghanistan-as-of-14-may-2024]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: Pléiades satellite imagery acquired on 14 May 2024 was analyzed by UNOSAT analysts through visual interpretation and multi-temporal comparison to delineate flood water extent and identify affected structures. The resulting water extent polygons and affected building counts represent post-event observed conditions in Baghlan-e-Jadid District.

sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis using Pléiades data to detect water extent and inundation areas from the May 2024 flood event in Afghanistan
